intro: Tasar North America 2027 schedule, headlined by the North American Championships at Harrison Hot Springs in September.
note: Dates marked TBD will be confirmed as host clubs publish their calendars.

events.title: Puget Sound Spring Regatta (PSSR)
events.description: CYC hosts a spring regatta for small boats out of the clubhouse at the north end of Shilshole Bay Marina in Seattle. Exact dates TBD.

events.title: Seattle Women's Tasar Invite
events.description: An invitational regatta for women Tasar sailors in Seattle. Exact dates and details TBD.

events.title: Cathlamet
events.description: Racing at Cathlamet on the Columbia River. These are target dates; details to follow.

events.title: Clinic / Fleet Building Event
events.description: A clinic and fleet-building event to help new and returning sailors get up to speed and meet the fleet. Date and location to be announced.

events.title: Skamania Coves Invitational Regatta
events.description: The annual Invitational regatta for Tasars and ILCA Masters, hosted by CGRA at the stunning Skamania Coves Resort — a beautiful 30-acre waterfront property on the Columbia River. A not-to-miss event!

events.title: Harrison Hot Springs Regatta + Tasar North American Championships
events.description: Travel to Harrison Hot Springs in British Columbia for a one-design regatta that will also serve as the Tasar North American Championships.

events.title: Tasar BC Regatta
events.description: The annual Tasar BC regatta at the Jericho Sailing Centre, racing on English Bay in Vancouver.

events.title: Puget Sound Sailing Championship (PSSC)
events.description: PSSC Small Boats regatta hosted at CYC Seattle out of their clubhouse at the north end of Shilshole Bay Marina. Exact dates TBD.

events.title: Turkey Bowl
events.description: Turkey Bowl Regatta hosted at CYC Seattle out of their clubhouse at the north end of Shilshole Bay Marina. Exact dates TBD.
